notes: 34 supported people, each associated with an independently named lunar crater; Curie and Sklodowska honor Pierre and Marie respectively. Lenard and Stark were dropped names, while the crater Bragg honors William Henry rather than William Lawrence; the search does not establish exhaustive completeness or independently verify future November 2026 changes.
